findings.failure_path: Rerunning with the same --raw-dir opens the deterministic capture filename with 'w', immediately truncating the previous record. An interrupt or write failure during json.dump leaves incomplete JSON and destroys the previous complete evidence. These nondeterministic model outputs cannot be recovered by rerunning.
findings.smallest_fix: Write to a temporary file in the destination directory, flush and close it, then atomically replace the capture.

findings.failure_path: D2 is marked fixed, but scope_anchor_runs.json is omitted from the bounded packet. The zero-count and complete-by-hand-audit claims therefore remain unverified.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply the complete sanitized per-run record with concern bindings, or retain D2 as open and label the affected measurements unverified.

findings.failure_path: D3 is only partially addressed. The supplied test checks a credential-shaped focus value without approval; the intent-route test, approval case, scanner/dispatch implementation and mutation results are absent. Ignoring intent secrets or rejecting an authorized override would still satisfy the visible focus-denial assertion.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply bounded scanner/dispatch code and synthetic intent/focus blocking and approval cases, or explicitly retain the unverified parts of D3.

findings.failure_path: D4 remains open: equal incoming profile hashes do not prove that a wrapper embeds challenge_focus in its model prompt. A Kimi adapter could discard it after capture while this assertion stays green; Codex and OpenCode are not exercised. The common forwarding implementation is also absent, so the every-reviewer claim remains unsupported.
findings.smallest_fix: Capture constructed prompts across supported adapters, or supply bounded forwarding code with equivalent coverage. Limit delivery claims to the demonstrated boundary meanwhile.

findings.failure_path: D5 is marked fixed with 'lane results ... recorded below', but no such results are supplied. findings.smallest_fix: Provide the candidate-bound make test command and result, or mark D5 and mandatory verification pending and remove the unsupported results pointer.
